accepted.sentence: It tightens or loosens threaded fasteners by turning the tool against their heads.
During assembly, users choose a tip that fits the head recess to reduce slipping and damage.
Seat the tip fully in the recess before applying turning force.
Keeping the shaft aligned with the fastener helps prevent the tip from slipping out.
Steady pressure against the fastener helps keep the tip engaged as the handle turns.
When removing a fastener, users continue turning until its threads clear the material.

item.sentence: Turning clockwise generally tightens a standard right-hand threaded fastener.
Turning counterclockwise generally loosens a standard right-hand threaded fastener.
